purpose: Test whether geographic representation differences have an equity dimension, rather than infer equity from selected coordinate errors.
primary_outcome: Compatible Overture fire_department primary or alternate category within 100 m of OSM fire-site geometry; 50 and 200 m sensitivity.
scope: Four completed historical OSM regions only. This is a conditional representation audit among OSM-mapped fire sites, not a census of operating fire stations or a service-access evaluation.
equity_axes: National 2022 SVI overall: low <=0.25, high >0.75, intermediate retained
Wildfire exposure: top quartile within each region over ALL supplied tracts
Tribal-area intersection: >=50% tract area, 0% comparison, intermediate overlap separate; distinguish legal/statistical geography; do not infer residents' identities
planned_intersections: Rurality × high SVI × high wildfire exposure
community_unit: Tracts containing at least one OSM fire site; explicitly report the subset with exactly one mapped fire site and no compatible Overture fire place near it. Tract population is contextual, not a service catchment or count of people harmed.

matched_comparison.algorithm: Maximum-cardinality minimum-distance matching without replacement, using only covariates, deterministic sorted GEOIDs. Squared distances scaled by caliper. Missing matching covariates excluded.
matched_comparison.outcome: Mean site correspondence per tract; report balance, overlap and unmatched rural population; paired bootstrap by rural county is descriptive uncertainty, not causal identification.

sensitivity_checks: Equal tract weights versus site weights
OSM last edit since 2020 and since 2023 (not proof of verification)
Region adjustment and needs covariates, then map-record covariates in supplemental linear probability models with county-clustered standard errors
reporting_rules: Report null or reversed vulnerability/tribal results and all planned intersections, not only the strongest cells
Report all subgroup denominators; mark <20 sites or <10 tracts as sparse
No protected identity inference from geographic area overlap
No claims of actual station absence, travel-time burden, dispatch use or observed harm without direct evidence
Exploratory follow-ups must be labeled; no causal claims from adjusted associations
CVI source vintage 2010 refers to tract geography crosswalked to 2020, not the age of all index observations; keep as a secondary descriptive check
